quest.title: New Horizons of Adventure
quest.description: Looks like Katheryne has something to tell you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mondstadt Shrine of Depths Key x1

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Greetings, Adventurer. The tales of your deeds are now known to all in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Continue in this fashion and you are destined to become one of the great Adventurers of our age.

choices.text: Got anything for me to do?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If you wish to become a great Adventurer, there comes a time when you must move beyond the places you know.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Now you have amassed such a wealth of adventuring experience, perhaps it is time for you to explore somewhere new.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Take this letter and deliver it to Liyue Katheryne.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Yes. I'm sure you will have no trouble finding her.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Anyway, once Liyue Katheryne has this letter, she will be your point of contact there for all your adventuring needs.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Of course, whenever you are back in Mondstadt I will still be delighted to be of service.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I would ask that you refrain from opening the letter en route. If anything were to fall out, it could cause complications.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Adventurer! The time has come for you to take the next step towards the stars and the abyss. Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: Should I call you "Mondstadt Katheryne" in the future, then?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If it helps advance your adventuring career, call me whatever you like.

choices.text: But Mondstadt is all I know...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: That is because your adventures this far have all been limited to the Mondstadt area.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: But all that is about to change. Soon, you will be able to venture into the world beyond.

talks.objective: Talk to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I have a letter for you.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I suspect this is for you...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: A letter? For me? Oh... So, you're an Adventurer from Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: What's this — a Dandelion? Why is there a Dandelion in the envelope?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Adventurer, did you place a Dandelion in this envelope to try and prove you are from Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: There's really no need. There is more than enough information contained in this letter to establish your identity and background.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Not that it really matters, of course.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: This letter from the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild says that you are a highly experienced Adventurer.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If that's true, I'm sure you are ready to take on Commissions from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: A whole new world of wild adventure awaits you. Ad astra abyssosque!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Katheryne? ...Oh, you must mean Mondstadt Katheryne.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Why did she put a Dandelion in with the letter? Very odd... A Dandelion isn't much use to an Adventurer, now, is it?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Not that it really matters, of course.
